Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding docs for Atlas billing / PO setup

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the invoice and heads up on timing — we can move quickly once vendor setup is complete on our side. To enable a PO and ACH payments, procurement needs a completed IRS Form W-9 (pdf) showing the legal business name and EIN, plus a remit/billing address. Could you attach your current W-9 and confirm the EIN (format xx-xxxxxxx) and the legal entity to be listed on the PO?

Also, if you have a vendor contact for ACH (name + email + last 4 of bank acct), please include that so payments can be routed once the PO is issued.

Target is to have a PO issued by EOD Friday if we have the W-9 and EIN validated.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
